mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% (the 20th percentile of historical levels), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a lower unemployment rate (i.e., a smaller value of UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and UNRATE < 5.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 110.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in the real economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 110.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts indicates strong consumer demand for durable goods and construction, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll employment growth falls below 137,000 jobs, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is below 137,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
